Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.description: Represents events, holidays, schedules, and leave requests.

id.description: Unique identifier of the calendar event

title.description: Short summary or name of the event

type.description: The category of the calendar item like Holiday, Leave, Work session

startDate.description: Form start ISO date on leave requests

endDate.description: Form end ISO date on leave requests

date.description: Specific single-day date for a custom calendar event or holiday

time.description: Time of day of the event

status.description: Review status of the event or request

priority.description: Importance weight like Normal, High or Low

assignee.description: Who represents the administrative contact of the event

createdBy.description: Employee name who created this event record

AccessLogs.title: AccessLogs
AccessLogs.description: Chronological audit log tracking application-wide security-sensitive logins and actions.

action.description: Keyword describing type of event logged

userAgent.description: Optional reporting browser user agent string metadata

SaleRevenue.title: SaleRevenue
SaleRevenue.description: CEO Portal Sales and revenue records imported via spreadsheet.

SaleComparison.title: SaleComparison
SaleComparison.description: CEO Portal monthly comparative sales projections and targets.

CostExpense.title: CostExpense
CostExpense.description: CEO Portal Operating expenses and operational cost metrics.

/Calendar/{eventId}.description: Global collection mapping individual calendar items, schedules, leaves, and notifications.

/AccessLogs/{logId}.description: Secure collection storing system logs of application actions and status logs.

/SaleRevenue/{recordId}.description: Spreadsheet sales and revenue logs synced from Google Sheets.

/SaleComparison/{recordId}.description: Comparative sales benchmarks by product and category.

/CostExpense/{recordId}.description: Monthly operating expenses and utilities tracked synchronously.
